## Finding

``` text
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1377 — HEREDOC uses `(?:.*?\n)*?` under re.S, so a `<<word` with no matching terminator line (a bit shift `$((1 << n))`, `echo "a <<b"`, a truncated heredoc) backtracks over every subset of the following newlines: measured 0.44 s at 20 trailing lines and 6.5 s at 24 (about ×15 per 4 lines), so a 30-line agent command hangs the grader on input the graded agent controls. Match body lines without DOTALL (`(?:[^\n]*\n)*?`) or scan line by line.
```
